question: The perimeter of a rhombus is 68 cm and one of its diagonals is 16 cm. Find the area of the rhombus.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d89518f6dea325513899043b1c5a02583ac0fcff244b1e61550c170d7835dbd3.png] 

**Given**

Perimeter of rhombus = 68 cm

One of the diagonal of rhombus = 16 cm

**Formula used**

Perimeter of rhombus = 2√(diagonal₁)² + (diagonal₂)²

**Calculation**

68 = 2√(16)² + (diagonal₂)²

⇒ 34 = √256 + (diagonal₂)²

squaring on both sides

⇒ 1156 = 256 + (diagonal₂)²

⇒ 1156 - 256 = (diagonal₂)²

⇒ 900 = (diagonal2)²

⇒ 30 = Diagonal₂

Area of rhombus = (1/2) × diagonal 1 × diagonal 2

⇒ (1/2) × 16 × 30

⇒ 16 × 15

⇒ 240 sq cm

**∴ Area of rhombus is 240 sq cm.**
